purpose: Pinned source of the Undertale Yellow assets this port merges. Yellow assets are fetched at build time and are never committed to Git; this record is what makes the fetch reproducible and auditable.
description: A Decompilation of UnderTale Yellow v1.2.1

project.role: resource order; independent evidence for every numeric asset ID

asset_order.role: decompiler dump of the compiled asset IDs; the IDs Yellow's own code uses as raw numbers

readme.role: states the decompiled game version and the GameMaker version

id_band.rule: merged ID = yellow_base + the asset's own ID in notes/Asset_Order/Asset_Order.txt, cross-checked against the Undertale_Yellow.yyp resource order

policy: Never fetch a branch or tag: the ref above is an immutable commit.
A digest mismatch is a hard failure that names both digests; nothing is patched or substituted.
yellow_src/ is git-ignored and reproducible from this record alone.
